grammar.pattern: 活动 / 性质 + 谓语
grammar.purpose: Use an activity or quality as the subject
grammar.explanation: 学习汉语需要时间 uses a verb phrase as the subject. 认真很重要 uses an adjective as the subject when talking about the quality of being careful. 早起对我来说不容易 uses an activity. Do not add a person to every subject or infer that every adjective can be used this way in every context.

examples.py: xué xí hàn yǔ xū yào shí jiān .
hé duì shí yàn jì lù yǒu bāng zhù .

commonMistakes.wrong: 学习汉语是需要时间人。
commonMistakes.why: The activity itself is the subject; no person noun is required.

grammar.pattern: V + 动作 / 性质 / 主谓短语
grammar.purpose: Identify a phrase as the object
grammar.explanation: 我喜欢学习汉语 has an activity as the object of 喜欢. 我喜欢安静 has a quality as its object. 我希望大家都看懂 has the subject–predicate phrase 大家都看懂 as the object of 希望. The lexical verb determines which complement is natural; do not interchange objects freely.

examples.py: wǒ xǐ huān xué xí hàn yǔ .

examples.zh: 我希望大家都看懂说明。
examples.py: wǒ xī wàng dà jiā dōu kàn dǒng shuō míng .
examples.en: I hope everyone understands the instructions.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我希望说明大家都看懂的。
commonMistakes.right: 我希望大家都看懂说明。
commonMistakes.why: Keep the embedded subject before its predicate and object.

lines.zh: 你手里这个小盒子是什么？
lines.py: nǐ shǒu lǐ zhè gè xiǎo hé zi shì shén me ?
lines.en: What's that little box in your hand?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我们课程上做的灯。打开以后，里面的纸会慢慢转。
lines.py: wǒ men kè chéng shàng zuò de dēng . dǎ kāi yǐ hòu , lǐ miàn de zhǐ huì màn màn zhuǎn .
lines.en: A lamp we made in class. When it's switched on, the paper inside turns slowly.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你做的？我还以为是店里买的。
lines.py: nǐ zuò de ? wǒ hái yǐ wéi shì diàn lǐ mǎi de .
lines.en: You made it? I thought you bought it in a shop.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 盒子是我做的，里面的小机器是老师给的。
lines.py: hé zi shì wǒ zuò de , lǐ miàn de xiǎo jī qì shì lǎo shī gěi de .
lines.en: I made the box; the teacher gave us the little mechanism inside.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我可以打开看看吗？
lines.py: wǒ kě yǐ dǎ kāi kàn kàn ma ?
lines.en: Can I switch it on and have a look?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 可以，先把它放在桌上。拿在手里会挡住下面。
lines.py: kě yǐ , xiān bǎ tā fàng zài zhuō shàng . ná zài shǒu lǐ huì dǎng zhù xià miàn .
lines.en: Sure. Put it on the table first. Holding it blocks the bottom.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 怎么只转了一下？
lines.py: zěn me zhǐ zhuǎn le yī xià ?
lines.en: Why did it only turn once?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 纸卡住了。我昨天也遇到这个问题，得把这边剪短一点。
lines.py: zhǐ kǎ zhù le . wǒ zuó tiān yě yù dào zhè gè wèn tí , děi bǎ zhè biān jiǎn duǎn yī diǎn .
lines.en: The paper's stuck. That happened yesterday too. I need to trim this edge.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我帮你拿着剪刀，你慢慢来。
lines.py: wǒ bāng nǐ ná zhe jiǎn dāo , nǐ màn màn lái .
lines.en: I'll hold the scissors for you. Take your time.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢。制作这个比我想的难，但终于有点样子了。
lines.py: xiè xiè . zhì zuò zhè gè bǐ wǒ xiǎng de nán , dàn zhōng yú yǒu diǎn yàng zi le .
lines.en: Thanks. It was harder to make than I expected, but it's taking shape at last.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: What is the learner showing the friend?

choices: It is catching against the box

reading.title: An activity can be a subject
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 姐姐是一位工程师，周末带我参加学校的科技活动。我想做一盏会转的小灯，她先问我有没有画图。
lines.py: jiě jie shì yī wèi gōng chéng shī , zhōu mò dài wǒ cān jiā xué xiào de kē jì huó dòng . wǒ xiǎng zuò yī zhǎn huì zhuǎn de xiǎo dēng , tā xiān wèn wǒ yǒu méi yǒu huà tú .
lines.en: My sister, an engineer, took me to a school technology event at the weekend. I wanted to make a small turning lamp; she first asked whether I'd drawn it.

lines.zh: 我说画图太慢，想直接开始。姐姐让我量一量纸盒，结果里面比我以为的小很多。
lines.py: wǒ shuō huà tú tài màn , xiǎng zhí jiē kāi shǐ . jiě jie ràng wǒ liàng yī liàng zhǐ hé , jié guǒ lǐ miàn bǐ wǒ yǐ wéi de xiǎo hěn duō .
lines.en: I said drawing was too slow and wanted to start. She asked me to measure the box. It was much smaller inside than I'd thought.

lines.zh: 做完以后，小机器能转，纸却总卡住。姐姐没有帮我全部重做，只让我看看是哪一边碰到了盒子。
lines.py: zuò wán yǐ hòu , xiǎo jī qì néng zhuǎn , zhǐ què zǒng kǎ zhù . jiě jie méi yǒu bāng wǒ quán bù zhòng zuò , zhǐ ràng wǒ kàn kàn shì nǎ yī biān pèng dào le hé zi .
lines.en: The mechanism turned, but the paper kept catching. Rather than rebuild everything, my sister asked me which edge was touching the box.

lines.zh: 我把纸剪短一点，再试一次。这次它转了一圈，我高兴得想马上拿回家给朋友看。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ zhǐ jiǎn duǎn yī diǎn , zài shì yī cì . zhè cì tā zhuǎn le yī quān , wǒ gāo xìng de xiǎng mǎ shàng ná huí jiā gěi péng you kàn .
lines.en: I trimmed the paper and tried again. It made a full turn. I was so pleased I wanted to take it home and show my friends immediately.

lines.zh: 姐姐说先把桌子上的东西收好。我一看，剪下来的纸比放进灯里的还多。
lines.py: jiě jie shuō xiān bǎ zhuō zi shàng de dōng xi shōu hǎo . wǒ yī kàn , jiǎn xià lái de zhǐ bǐ fàng jìn dēng lǐ de hái duō .
lines.en: My sister reminded me to clear the table first. There was more scrap paper on it than paper inside the lamp.

lines.zh: 回家以后，我把灯放在书架上。朋友问它能不能一直转，我说能，但最好别让我的猫发现。
lines.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ dēng fàng zài shū jià shàng . péng you wèn tā néng bù néng yì zhí zhuǎn , wǒ shuō néng , dàn zuì hǎo bié ràng wǒ de māo fā xiàn .
lines.en: At home I put the lamp on the bookshelf. A friend asked whether it could keep turning. I said yes, as long as my cat didn't discover it.

questions.q: How does the narrator get the lamp working?
choices: Measure and trim the paper after a failed try
Ask the cat to build it
questions.answer: Measure and trim the paper after a failed try

questions.q: What does the sister ask for before going home?
What does the final cat remark suggest?
choices: The cat might interfere with the lamp
The cat has designed the machine
The lamp is intended only for cats
questions.answer: The cat might interfere with the lamp

lines.zh: 你说这是自己做的，我差点就信了。
lines.py: nǐ shuō zhè shì zì jǐ zuò de , wǒ chà diǎn jiù xìn le .
lines.en: When you said you made it, I almost believed you.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 真是我做的！只是机器不是我做的。
lines.py: zhēn shì wǒ zuò de ! zhǐ shì jī qì bù shì wǒ zuò de .
lines.en: I did! Just not the mechanism.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那猫也能算帮忙吧？它刚才把纸从桌上推下来了。
lines.py: nà māo yě néng suàn bāng máng ba ? tā gāng cái bǎ zhǐ cóng zhuō shàng tuī xià lái le .
lines.en: Can we count the cat as a helper too? It pushed the paper off the table.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 它负责检查我有没有收好东西。
lines.py: tā fù zé jiǎn chá wǒ yǒu méi yǒu shōu hǎo dōng xi .
lines.en: Its job is checking whether I've put things away.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 看来检查结果不太好。
lines.py: kàn lái jiǎn chá jié guǒ bù tài hǎo .
lines.en: That check doesn't seem to have gone very well.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你别笑了，帮我把纸捡起来。
lines.py: nǐ bié xiào le , bāng wǒ bǎ zhǐ jiǎn qǐ lái .
lines.en: Stop laughing and help me pick up the paper.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 真是我做的！只是【机器】不是我做的。
lines.py: zhēn shì wǒ zuò de ! zhǐ shì jī qì bù shì wǒ zuò de .
lines.en: I did! Just not the mechanism.
lines.speaker: b

lines.en: They're developing a new study tool.

lines.zh: 公司开发的工具现在已经能用了。
lines.py: gōng sī kāi fā de gōng jù xiàn zài yǐ jīng néng yòng le .
lines.en: The company's new tool is now ready to use.

lines.zh: 她对科技新闻很感兴趣。
lines.py: tā duì kē jì xīn wén hěn gǎn xìng qù .
lines.en: She's interested in science and technology news.

lines.zh: 这个科技节目介绍了几种新的机器。
lines.py: zhè gè kē jì jié mù jiè shào le jǐ zhǒng xīn de jī qì .
lines.en: This science and technology programme introduced several new machines.

lines.zh: 这家医院有先进的设备。
lines.py: zhè jiā yī yuàn yǒu xiān jìn de shè bèi .
lines.en: This hospital has advanced equipment.

lines.zh: 这些先进的方法也需要人认真使用。
lines.py: zhè xiē xiān jìn de fāng fǎ yě xū yào rén rèn zhēn shǐ yòng .
lines.en: These advanced methods also need to be used carefully.

lines.zh: 这座城市正在进行现代化建设。
lines.py: zhè zuò chéng shì zhèng zài jìn xíng xiàn dài huà jiàn shè .
lines.en: This city is undergoing modernisation.

lines.zh: 办公室的工作越来越信息化了。
lines.py: bàn gōng shì de gōng zuò yuè lái yuè xìn xī huà le .
lines.en: The office's work is becoming increasingly computerised.

lines.zh: 我姐姐是一位工程师。
lines.py: wǒ jiě jie shì yī wèi gōng chéng shī .
lines.en: My sister is an engineer.

lines.zh: 那位工程师给我们画了一张图。
lines.py: nà wèi gōng chéng shī gěi wǒ men huà le yī zhāng tú .
lines.en: That engineer drew a diagram for us.

lines.zh: 这家工厂离车站不远。
lines.py: zhè jiā gōng chǎng lí chē zhàn bù yuǎn .
lines.en: This factory isn't far from the station.

lines.zh: 他在这家工厂工作了十年。
lines.py: tā zài zhè jiā gōng chǎng gōng zuò le shí nián .
lines.en: He's worked at this factory for ten years.

lines.zh: 这座城市过去主要发展工业。
lines.py: zhè zuò chéng shì guò qù zhǔ yào fā zhǎn gōng yè .
lines.en: This city previously developed industry as its main activity.

lines.zh: 这本书介绍了当地工业的变化。
lines.py: zhè běn shū jiè shào le dāng dì gōng yè de biàn huà .
lines.en: This book describes changes in local industry.

lines.zh: 这家工厂生产儿童玩具。
lines.py: zhè jiā gōng chǎng shēng chǎn ér tóng wán jù .
lines.en: This factory produces children's toys.

lines.zh: 他们从下个月开始生产这种材料。
lines.py: tā men cóng xià gè yuè kāi shǐ shēng chǎn zhè zhǒng cái liào .
lines.en: They'll start producing this material next month.

lines.zh: 他们制造的机器卖到很多地方。
lines.py: tā men zhì zào de jī qì mài dào hěn duō dì fāng .
lines.en: The machines they manufacture are sold in many places.

lines.zh: 这家公司的工作是制造汽车。
lines.py: zhè jiā gōng sī de gōng zuò shì zhì zào qì chē .
lines.en: This company manufactures cars.

lines.zh: 我们一起制作了一本小相册。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ zhì zuò le yī běn xiǎo xiāng cè .
lines.en: We made a little photo album together.

lines.zh: 她制作了一段介绍家乡的视频。
lines.py: tā zhì zuò le yī duàn jiè shào jiā xiāng de shì pín .
lines.en: She made a video introducing her hometown.

lines.zh: 这些材料还需要加工。
lines.py: zhè xiē cái liào hái xū yào jiā gōng .
lines.en: These materials still need processing.

lines.zh: 加工以后，木头的表面很平。
lines.py: jiā gōng yǐ hòu , mù tou de biǎo miàn hěn píng .
lines.en: After processing, the wood's surface is smooth.

lines.zh: 机器做完以后，还有一次人工检查。
lines.py: jī qì zuò wán yǐ hòu , hái yǒu yī cì rén gōng jiǎn chá .
lines.en: After the machine finishes, there's a manual check.

lines.zh: 这里的检查主要靠人工完成。
lines.py: zhè lǐ de jiǎn chá zhǔ yào kào rén gōng wán chéng .
lines.en: Checks here are mostly carried out manually.

lines.zh: 这台机器下午就能修好。
lines.py: zhè tái jī qì xià wǔ jiù néng xiū hǎo .
lines.en: This machine can be fixed this afternoon.

lines.zh: 先把机器关了，再清理桌子。
lines.py: xiān bǎ jī qì guān le , zài qīng lǐ zhuō zi .
lines.en: Switch off the machine before clearing the table.

lines.zh: 新设备到了，旧的还留着。
lines.py: xīn shè bèi dào le , jiù de hái liú zhe .
lines.en: The new equipment has arrived; we're keeping the old equipment too.

lines.zh: 教室里的设备是去年买的。
lines.py: jiào shì lǐ de shè bèi shì qù nián mǎi de .
lines.en: The classroom equipment was bought last year.

lines.zh: 我们明天做这个实验。
lines.py: wǒ men míng tiān zuò zhè gè shí yàn .
lines.en: We'll carry out this experiment tomorrow.

lines.zh: 这次实验的结果跟上次不同。
lines.py: zhè cì shí yàn de jié guǒ gēn shàng cì bù tóng .
lines.en: This experiment's result differs from the last one.

lines.zh: 老师在实验室等我们。
lines.py: lǎo shī zài shí yàn shì děng wǒ men .
lines.en: The teacher's waiting for us in the laboratory.

lines.zh: 实验室下午五点关门。
lines.py: shí yàn shì xià wǔ wǔ diǎn guān mén .
lines.en: The laboratory closes at five in the afternoon.

lines.zh: 新办法先进行一次试验。
lines.py: xīn bàn fǎ xiān jìn xíng yī cì shì yàn .
lines.en: The new approach will undergo a trial first.

lines.zh: 试验结束以后，我们换了一种材料。
lines.py: shì yàn jié shù yǐ hòu , wǒ men huàn le yī zhǒng cái liào .
lines.en: After the trial, we switched materials.

lines.zh: 这个方案从下个月开始实行。
lines.py: zhè gè fāng àn cóng xià gè yuè kāi shǐ shí xíng .
lines.en: This plan will be implemented next month.

lines.zh: 学校已经开始实行新的安排。
lines.py: xué xiào yǐ jīng kāi shǐ shí xíng xīn de ān pái .
lines.en: The school has begun implementing the new arrangements.

lines.zh: 几位专家一起讨论了这个问题。
lines.py: jǐ wèi zhuān jiā yì qǐ tǎo lùn le zhè gè wèn tí .
lines.en: Several specialists discussed this issue together.

lines.zh: 我想请专家看看这份计划。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng qǐng zhuān jiā kàn kàn zhè fèn jì huà .
lines.en: I'd like a specialist to look at this plan.

audio.zh: 纸卡住了。我昨天也遇到这个问题，得把这边剪短一点。
audio.py: zhǐ kǎ zhù le . wǒ zuó tiān yě yù dào zhè gè wèn tí , děi bǎ zhè biān jiǎn duǎn yī diǎn .
audio.en: The paper's stuck. That happened yesterday too. I need to trim this edge.

tasks.statement: The paper is caught inside the box.
tasks.why: The sentence explicitly supplies this information.

audio.zh: 回家以后，我把灯放在书架上。朋友问它能不能一直转，我说能，但最好别让我的猫发现。
audio.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ bǎ dēng fàng zài shū jià shàng . péng you wèn tā néng bù néng yì zhí zhuǎn , wǒ shuō néng , dàn zuì hǎo bié ràng wǒ de māo fā xiàn .
audio.en: At home I put the lamp on the bookshelf. A friend asked whether it could keep turning. I said yes, as long as my cat didn't discover it.

tasks.statement: The friend takes the lamp away.
tasks.why: The final passage explicitly describes a different outcome.

choices: 放在桌上，别拿手挡住下面。
tasks.answer: 放在桌上，别拿手挡住下面。

Language practice is not laboratory operating instruction. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三32 / 三53 / 三39 / 三52: 老师张先生也来了。, 她汉语说得很流利。, 从下周起，每天先读一段。, 她离开这里三天了。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Removed grammar-analysis and permission disclaimers from character speech. The scene has one practical problem and a coherent timeline; unrelated vocabulary now has independent examples. Dates, times, causal questions and distractors were checked against their own passage. Every Chinese line still needs native review; particular flags: lamp mechanism 卡/转, 功夫/工夫 register, liǎo in 没完没了, casual travel teasing and the 信 trust sense. No scene claims that emailing constitutes a booking. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
